changelog: Notifications rebuilt to the A_1.2 handoff: rows lose the red card and become full-width entries on the page background with a full-bleed ink-9 hairline, a 40px ink-9 icon circle routed to the battery / solar / outage glyph, a body_medium/semibold title, a tiny/ink-4 '{device} - {detail}' line, and the timestamp aligned to its first line.
Timestamps are relative the way the design shows them: 'Just now', '4 mins ago', 'Today 3:42 PM', then 'May 3'.
Unread rows carry the design's danger dot, backed by a new seen list in the alarm store; entering the page snapshots what is new, then marks everything read.
Clearing moved from an inline Clear pill to the design's swipe-left red trash panel (72px).
Demo low-battery alarm now carries a lowBattery key so it resolves to a short title with the message as the detail, matching the design's two-line row.
